name: New General Service List (NGSL)
creator: Charles Browne, Brent Culligan, and Joseph Phillips
delivery: bundled with the app so Streamlit deployments have one open frequency list by default
notes: The stats file supplies rank order via SFI Rank.
The lemmatized-for-research file supplies inflected forms mapped to each headword.
The public open_flemma normalizer verifies the research file SHA-256, retains source collisions as ambiguous, and combines it with project-owned inflection rules.
Derived rank_map size depends on the loader's duplicate handling and normalization.
